intro: The Tome of Divinity is a sacred trial undertaken by paladins seeking to prove their devotion to the Holy Light. Guided by Duthorian Rall in Stormwind's Cathedral of Light, initiates must demonstrate selflessness, charity, and an unwavering commitment to protect those in need.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I'll take these to the children this very day. Please be safe, good adventurer. It is not often men of your character show their faces in the city, but you've proven that the adventurers here in Stormwind shall never turn their backs on those in need.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You've returned so quickly, friend. And what have you accomplished in your time away from the Cathedral?

Have you helped a noble cause? Perhaps you've learned the value of charity or some more about your obligations to the citizens of Azeroth. Tell me, who have you helped and how.... Well, I'm impressed, friend, those are surely the actions of one who follows the Light and values others above oneself.
Such sacrifice will always be rewarded in time.
